cues: The enthalpy change of a reaction is equal in size and opposite in sign to that of the reverse reaction.
Burning carbon releases three ninety three point five kilojoules, so decomposing carbon dioxide into carbon and oxygen needs exactly that much.
If not, you could run the reaction round in a loop and make energy from nothing.
text: The Lavoisier Laplace law. The enthalpy change of a reaction is equal in size and opposite in sign to that of the reverse reaction. Burning carbon releases three ninety three point five kilojoules, so decomposing carbon dioxide into carbon and oxygen needs exactly that much. If not, you could run the reaction round in a loop and make energy from nothing.
